mapper.sql: id, item_code, name, description, category_code, unit, unit_price, currency, preferred_vendor_id, reorder_point, is_active, created_at, created_by, updated_by
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT item_code, SUM(quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand FROM inventory.stock_entries WHERE is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY item_code ) stock ON stock.item_code = item.item_code
mapper.select: SELECT FROM inventory.items item WHERE item.item_code = #{itemCode} AND item.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT item.id, item.item_code, item.name, item.description, item.category_code, item.unit, item.unit_price, item.currency, item.preferred_vendor_id, item.reorder_point, item.is_active, item.created_at, item.created_by, item.updated_by FROM inventory.items item
ORDER BY item.name ASC, item.item_code ASC LIMIT #{filter.size} OFFSET #{filter.offset}

SELECT se.warehouse_id, wh.name AS warehouse_name, se.quantity_on_hand, se.unit FROM inventory.stock_entries se JOIN inventory.warehouses wh ON wh.id = se.warehouse_id AND wh.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE se.item_code = #{itemCode} AND se.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY wh.name ASC, se.warehouse_id ASC
SELECT id, idempotency_key, operation, item_code, actor_id, created_at FROM inventory.catalog_item_mutation_requests WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND is_deleted = FALSE
